## [0.9.2] - 2026-09-25

### 修复
- 默认音频设备切换瞬间滚动滚轮不再把旧设备的音量写进新端点。
- 音量或静音读取失败时保留上一次有效状态，不再误设为 50% 音量与未静音。
- 托盘菜单的刷新操作可重新注册睡眠恢复或音频服务重启后断开的音量通知回调。
- 旧版配置文件导入时若向新路径写入失败仍会在会话中保留已读配置，保存中断时会清理未完成的临时文件。

### Fixed
- Rolling the wheel while switching the default audio device no longer writes the old device's volume to the new endpoint.
- Failed volume or mute reads preserve the last known state instead of falling back to 50% volume and unmuted.
- Refreshing from the tray menu now re-arms volume notification callbacks if sleep-resume or an audio service restart disconnected them.
- Legacy configuration imports preserve settings in memory when saving to the new path fails, and interrupted saves clean up unfinished temporary files.
